name: 施設の質問候補の横並び
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0072 施設の質問候補の横並び. Input1 ORIGINAL shows two horizontal suggestion-chip rows; input2 native mock controls Japanese copy and Regular type. Preserve two-row arrangement and source pill geometry/comfortable gaps, no heading/input.
Purewhite#FFFFFF surface. Two separate unselected white rounded pill buttons with fine neutral#DDE1E4 outlines, no colored fill. Row1 exact "どのような料理がありますか"; Row2 exact "店内はどのような雰囲気ですか". Both Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent, tracking0, dark#1D1D1D. Identical size/weight/lineheight in both rows; no bold, no selected emphasis. Natural one-line labels with comfortable16logicalpx horizontal padding, full rounded ends, no bottom clipping. Row2 slightly longer pill based on label width; align left edges. Compact vertical gap8logicalpx. Keep native component's compact scale, only small white outer margins.
These are neutral suggestions, no primary/selected state; no green fill/underline/dot. No icons, carets, photos, title, English, extra invented suggestions, backdrop card or shadow. Flat high-resolution isolated two-row component raster; suggestion-selection/scroll behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Two Japanese question suggestions retain two-row layout with complete rounded pill bounds, white neutral outlines, Regular labels, no false selected state. Readable copy and spacing reviewed. Raster candidate only; exact font identity, scroll/action runtime and owner approval unverified.
